lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh saran charan chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, I focus my consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: supan kee baat sunee pekhee supanaa naam ma(n)tr satiguroo driRaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When I was dreaming, I heard and saw only dream-objects. The True Guru has implanted the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੋ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah tripataano raaj joban dhan bahur bahur phir dhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Power, youth and wealth do not bring satisfaction; people chase after them again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sukh paaiaa trisanaa sabh bujhee hai saa(n)t paaee gun gaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: I have found peace and tranquility, and all my thirsty desires have been quenched, singing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੂ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin boojhe pasoo kee niaaee bhram mohi biaapio maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without understanding, they are like beasts, engrossed in doubt, emotional attachment and Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jam jevaree kaatee naanak sahaj samaaiaa ||2||10||
lines.translation: But in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the noose of Death is cut, O Nanak, and one intuitively merges in celestial peace. ||2||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke charan hiradai gaai ||
lines.translation: Sing of the Lord's Feet within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetalaa sukh saa(n)t moorat simar simar nit dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditate, meditate in constant remembrance on God, the Embodiment of soothing peace and cooling tranquility. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਹੋਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sagal aas hot pooran kot janam dukh jaai ||1||
lines.translation: All your hopes shall be fulfilled, and the pain of millions of deaths and births shall be gone. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pu(n)n daan anek kiriaa saadhoo sa(n)g samaai ||
lines.translation: Immerse yourself in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and you shall obtain the benefits of giving charitable gifts, and all sorts of good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: taap sa(n)taap mite naanak baahuR kaal na khaai ||2||11||
lines.translation: Sorrow and suffering shall be erased, O Nanak, and you shall never again be devoured by death. ||2||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥੀਐ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: katheeai sa(n)tasa(n)g prabh giaan ||
lines.translation: Speak of God's Wisdom in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran param jot paramesur simarat paaeeai maan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Supreme Divine Light, the Transcendent Lord God, honor and glory are obtained. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਰਹੇ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸੇ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat rahe sram naase simarat saadhoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: One's comings and goings in reincarnation cease, and suffering is dispelled, meditating in remembrance in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: patit puneet hohi khin bheetar paarabraham kai ra(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: Sinners are sanctified in an instant, in the love of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਥੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo kathai sunai har keeratan taa kee duramat naas ||
lines.translation: Whoever speaks and listens to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is rid of evil-mindedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath paavai naanak pooran hovai aas ||2||1||12||
lines.translation: All hopes and desires, O Nanak, are fulfilled. ||2||1||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat nidh har ko naam ||
lines.translation: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee jee kai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It is the Companion of the soul, its Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t ren nit majan karai ||
lines.translation: Continually bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh harai ||1||
lines.translation: the sins of countless incarnations are washed away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਚੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee oochee baanee ||
lines.translation: The words of the humble Saints are lofty and exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar tare naanak praanee ||2||2||13||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, mortal beings are carried across and saved. ||2||2||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo har hare gun gaai ||
lines.translation: O Holy people, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Haray.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan tan dhan praan prabh ke simarat dukh jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Mind, body, wealth and the breath of life - all come from God; remembering Him in meditation, pain is taken away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਹਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਵਹਿ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: eet oot kahaa loubhaavahi ek siu man laai ||1||
lines.translation: Why are you entangled in this and that? Let your mind be attuned to the One. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤ ਆਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa pavitr sa(n)t aasan mil sa(n)g gobid dhiaai ||2||
lines.translation: The place of the Saints is utterly sacred; meet with them, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sagal tiaag saran aaio naanak lehu milaai ||3||3||14||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I have abandoned everything and come to Your Sanctuary. Please let me merge with You. ||3||3||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਉ ਸਾਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਇਕਾਂਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekh pekh bigasaau saajan prabh aapanaa ikaa(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon and beholding my Best Friend, I blossom forth in bliss; my God is the One and Only. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aanadaa sukh sahaj moorat tis aan naahee bhaa(n)t ||1||
lines.translation: He is the Image of Ecstasy, Intuitive Peace and Poise. There is no other like Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਜਾਂਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: simarat ik baar har har mit kot kasamal jaa(n)t ||2||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, even once, millions of sins are erased. ||2||
